prompt: Look at the picture and choose the statement that best describes it.
promptZh: 請看圖片，選出最符合畫面的敘述。

options.text: Some tools are hanging from a wall bracket.
options.zh: 有幾件工具掛在牆上的掛架上。
options.whyZh: 牆上的掛架是空的，工具放在推車裡。

options.text: A wheel has been removed from a cart.
options.zh: 推車有一個輪子被拆了。
options.whyZh: 側面可見的兩個輪子均裝在車上，沒有輪子拆下的跡象。

options.text: A cart is being loaded into a van.
options.zh: 有人正在把推車裝進廂型車。
options.whyZh: 畫面沒有廂型車或將推車抬起的動作。

options.text: Several long-handled tools are sticking out of a cart.
options.zh: 幾件長柄工具從推車裡伸出來。
options.whyZh: 可見幾件長柄工具從推車內向上伸出，沒有掛在牆上。

explanationZh: 可見幾件長柄工具從推車內向上伸出，沒有掛在牆上。
evidence: Several long-handled tools are sticking out of a cart.

vocabulary.note: Several long-handled tools are sticking out of a cart.
